"PREMIER PLAY" has three of three top prizes left and is still new. Only a small slice of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

If "PREMIER PLAY" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2414.headline: Early stage or late

2415.body:
About half of the tickets for "Double The Money" have been sold. The game is in the middle of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Tomorrow's count on "Double The Money" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2415.headline: Tickets sold so far

2416.body:
"Loaded with $2,000s" is well into its run, with about a third of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

If "Loaded with $2,000s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2416.headline: How far along this game is

2419.body:
"Bronze 7s" has 109,302 prizes of $1 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $250 prize, with fourteen left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Tomorrow's count on "Bronze 7s" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2419.headline: A close look at the prizes

2420.body:
The most common win left on "Silver 7s" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $7,000, and two of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Every line of Silver 7s's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2420.headline: The prize table, line by line

2421.body:
"Gold 7s" has gone two weeks without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About a third of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $577,777 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Everything above about "Gold 7s" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2421.headline: No new top prize claims

2422.body:
"Platinum 7s" offers a top prize of $2 million and eleven prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward the smaller prizes. Games shaped like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

If you play "Platinum 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.

The numbers for "HAUNTED HUNDREDS" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.

Every line of HOLIDAY TRIPLER's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
